title: Change-summary playbook and stakeholder review matrix for customer and internal updates
creator: Aisha Patel
description: A concise playbook and sign-off matrix to streamline drafting, reviewing, and publishing change summaries (customer-facing and internal). This ticket produces a template pack, stakeholder assignments, a gated review flow, and a lightweight checklist that product, eng, design, and legal can follow during the next two minor releases.
acceptance_criteria: One customer-facing change summary template and one internal digest template exist in Confluence (linked)
Stakeholder matrix with named owners for messaging, tech details, and legal signoff published
Runbook for last-minute rollback/update published with communication channels and escalation paths
At least one pilot release used the playbook and feedback incorporated
tasks: Draft customer-facing two-paragraph summary template and sample bullets
Build internal digest template with token/cost/impact notes and rollouts section
Create stakeholder review matrix (names, SLAs for review) and attach to templates
Schedule 30min pilot review with Eng Lead, Design Lead, Legal Counsel
Publish templates to Confluence and create a GitHub PR that auto-populates release notes from PR body
